desc.en: A port of Gearsystem, a highly accurate Sega 8-bit emulator by Ignacio Sanchez, to libretro. It runs Master System / Mark III, Game Gear and SG-1000 games, and faithfully emulates the hardware, including undocumented features of the Z80 CPU.
desc.zh: [Gearsystem] 是由 Ignacio Sanchez 开发的高精度世嘉 8 位主机模拟器 Gearsystem 的 Libretro 移植版。它可以运行 Master System / Mark III、Game Gear 与 SG-1000 游戏，忠实还原硬件特性，包括 Z80 处理器的未公开功能。
